services.name: Molokini and Turtle Town Snorkel Adventure  Aboard the Calypso
services.desc: Join us for an Epic Molokini Crater Snorkeling Adventure! A Molokini snorkeling adventure aboard Calypso is the most fun on Maui! This stable, high-speed, triple-decker catamaran will get you to two snorkel sites fast: Molokini Crater and Turtle Town, and with all the equipment you need and plenty of food on board, what more could you ask for? You’ll be welcomed aboard by our friendly crew and enjoy a delicious, hearty breakfast. After everyone is settled in, it’s off to the most popular underwater destination in Maui for some morning Molokini snorkeling! services.name: From Ma'alaea Harbor:  Whale Watch Cruise Aboard the Calypso
services.desc: Experience the awe-inspiring behaviors of the Humpback whales on this incredible whale watching adventure Come aboard the Calypso a power catamaran with three decks each providing excellent vantage points for viewing the Humpback whales. Whether you are seated outside on the upper decks or inside the shaded cabin all feel like front row seats. Our Captain will provide an expert narrative of the Humpback whale's historical significance in Maui waters and "play-by-play" commentary of the incredible whale behaviors as you view them. Have your cameras ready to capture these majestic creatures All Ages • 2 Hours • Departs Daily @ 8:00AM, 10:30AM, 2:00PM, & 3:30PM (November - April)

From Ma'alaea Harbor: Thanksgiving Dinner Cruise Aboard the Calypso
services.desc: Give thanks Hawaiian style on this special holiday dinner cruise aboard the Calypso. Relax with family and friends, listen to music, and enjoy the spectacular views of the West Maui Mountains and neighboring islands on Molokai and Lanai as we cruise the calm Maui waters. Sip on cocktails, beer, and wine as our crew serves you table-side a Hawaiian-influenced Thanksgiving day feast with all the fixings. The Calypso is a triple-decker power catamaran with a spacious deck and plenty of comfortable table and chair seating for everyone. quotes.text: We had a large group with small children. The crew was very accommodating and friendly! They made sure we had a spot together on the boat and were comfortable! They had all the right equipment to make snorkeling doable for all skill levels and ages including a viewing board to allow my 2 year old niece to see the ocean bottom. The food was great! The boat was clean and spacious! The family said it was a highlight of the trip! We would definitely do it again!

An absolute must do. This is an awesome adventure for the price. You get to stop at two locations and even if you only get out and snorkel at one it is way worth it for the cost. Molokini was incredible and clear. The crew on this boat makes everything even better the captain is funny, friendly, gives clear helpful instructions to snorkel newbies like myself and they have everything they can for sea sickness. Truly an amazing time with the Calypso.

This trip was amazing. Having a big boat was worth it. Sure there were more people. But when there was a heavy surf we barely noticed. The food for both breakfast and lunch was great!!! Also on the ride back they gave out some little ice creams too! The photographer Marley is amazing at photographing and he has both go pros and nice camera to use in the water. This was 100% worth it.

Me and my friend got to go on the dinner cruise. The captain was great, the boat was very nice, we loved the live music(Alex is very talented), the crew was good and the food and views were amazing! Thanks for an unforgettable evening aboard the Calypso!

We took our kids (6 & 11) and we had a blast! The highlight was swimming with a turtle for sure. Every just seeing the cool fish was amazing. The girls loved the slides off the boat and the food was good. Definitely would do it again

quotes.text: Great experience! Enjoyed the large boat. The crew were awesome, friendly and professional! The food was delicious! It was two fabulous snorkeling spots!
